correctness.rationale: Exact forced-multiplicity bijection and layer-cake decomposition prove finite identity. Euler product and classical coefficient Ingham theorem prove p_ell(n) asymptotic, with monotonicity from part 1; its order-sqrt(n) shift ratio yields the joint survivor. Squared-gap exponential-minimum law reproduces all orthant survivors. 9600 independent brute-force finite joint counts agree. Risks: reliance on classical Ingham and no quantitative rate.

value.rationale: Single-r marginal laws do not determine dependence. Exact simultaneous survivor formula for arbitrary thresholds and explicit running-minimum process give the multivariate joint behavior and limiting coalescence mechanism. This natural statistic of regular partitions has a clear research motivation and is not a table recomputation. Does not claim growing R or exact finite-size tie asymptotics.
